A ''glide'' is '''i''' or '''u''' when followed by a [[Morphology: syllables|nucleus]] and not followed by abother ''glide''.

A ''diphthong'' is one of '''ai''',  '''au''', '''ei''', '''oi''' not followed by a ''glide''.

A ''vowel'' is one of '''a''', '''e''', '''i''', '''o''', '''u''' not followed by a [[Morphology: syllables|nucleus]].

'''a''' is any number of [[Morphology: special characters|commas]] (possibly none) and the character 'a' or 'A'.

'''e''' is any number of [[Morphology: special characters|commas]] (possibly none) and the character 'e' or 'E'.

'''i''' is any number of [[Morphology: special characters|commas]] (possibly none) and the character 'i' or 'I'.

'''o''' is any number of [[Morphology: special characters|commas]] (possibly none) and the character 'o' or 'O'.

'''u''' is any number of [[Morphology: special characters|commas]] (possibly none) and the character 'u' or 'U'.

'''y''' is any number of [[Morphology: special characters|commas]] (possibly none) and the character 'y' or 'Y'.
